id_grammar.marketplace_name: validated (`marketplace name \`X\` is invalid`); grammar not measured

validator_note: `muse plugins validate` and `muse plugins install` both accept these ids with zero diagnostics; the warning (`installed plugin \`X\` uses a reserved bundled plugin id; the bundled plugin wins and the installed plugin contributes nothing`) appears only in `plugins list` / `plugins inspect`. omm lint must reject them itself (R19).

reserved_marketplace_names.name: tbh-curated
reserved_marketplace_names.behaviour: `marketplace \`tbh-curated\` is reserved and cannot be added` (code invalid-plugin-package); also `… cannot be removed`. Provenance value `curated` exists; the registry is empty in both builds.

bundled_reminder_capability_ids.note: Capability ids, not plugin ids; a third-party plugin may reuse them (e.g. plugin:zzcap:reminder:skill-reminder approved fine) but cannot reach settings.plugins through them.

bundled_skill_ids_note: Namespaced as bundled:<id>; a project/user skill with the same bare id shadows the bare selector, never the qualified id. See bundled-skills.json.

windows_reserved_stems.note: Authoring/portability rule from the bundled create-skill body and the plugin contract's idRules.windowsReservedBasenames (case-folded basename before the first dot). Measured VALID by `plugins validate` for con, prn, aux, nul, com1, com9, lpt1, lpt9, con.txt, lpt1.log (plugin-contract D4). Keep the check in omm lint.

builtin_tool_names.note: The 26-tool active set of an echo session. A plugin hook's `compatibilityName` must not collide with a built-in tool matcher name (`compatibilityName \`Bash\` collides with a built-in tool matcher name`); `read_skill`, `write_todos`, `subagent_*` are not removable via run.toolset. Gated additions: monitor, web_fetch, request_user_input, shell, artifact, code_exec/code_wait, list_peer_sessions/send_session_message. Since 1.3.0-R3057.1 the default set grows by three (`work_stop` after `edit_memory`, `work_status` and `snooze_reminder` before `write_todos`; trusted order, echo session). `work_stop` cancels a runtime-owned work item, `work_status` reads one, `snooze_reminder` suppresses async reminders.
builtin_tool_names.mcp_tool_name_form: mcp__plugin_<pid>_<sid>__<tool>; survives verbatim to 31 chars, 32+ rewritten to first-17 + "__" + 12 hex → len(pid) + len(sid) ≤ 18

namespace_prefixes.capability_stable_ids: plugin:<pid>:<kind>:<cap-id> with kind ∈ hook | reminder | mcp_server | agent_definition
namespace_prefixes.permission_profiles: built-ins carry a leading colon (:read-only, :ask-me, :auto-review, :unrestricted) so user ids can never collide

reserved_reminder_envelope_tags.note: A third-party reminder whose envelope template uses a host-reserved tag cannot be activated headlessly (only the TUI's elevated-approval path clears `reminder_envelope_elevated_approval`). omm must not generate one.
tags: <continue> (retired: `envelope template uses retired reserved tag continue`)

reserved_key_bindings.note: tui.keymap: `/ ! @ ?` are route characters — rejected for navigation.focus-plan; app.commands / app.shell / app.files must be exactly one printable character.

reserved_hook_names.note: Native plugin hook fields `matcher`, `silent`, `description` are rejected; the Claude event `Setup` is recognised but never run; a hook `compatibilityName` is checked for cross-plugin ownership at install.

telemetry_bucket: Plugin-command and skill-shortcut dispatches are reported as the literal slash-command name `custom`.

omm_identity.constraint: len("oh-my-musecode") + len(server-id) ≤ 18, so the MCP server id stays ≤ 4 chars (`doc`); every skill/command/capability id omm- prefixed and linted against the 9 reserved ids, the 15 bundled skill ids and the 39 slash-command rows (plus the 6 hidden built-ins and 9 aliases in slash-commands.json). Marketplace name `omm`, recorded in omm-manifest (`MARKETPLACE_NAME`).
